title: Fleet Manager -> DevGate core: capacity decision (contract v1)
description: The only document shape in which Fleet Manager answers a capacity request (REPO-003). Producer: Fleet Manager. Consumer: core. A non-zero answer is a typed outcome, never an absent document: 'unavailable' is a stated state, not a timeout the core side has to guess at.

request_id.description: Echo of the request's request_id. A decision that cannot be matched to a request is not a decision.

outcome.description: assigned: capacity exists now. queued: it will. refused: policy says no. unavailable: Fleet Manager cannot answer — the core side must degrade explicitly and must never read this as pass.

assignment.description: Present iff outcome is assigned (cross-field rule enforced in fleet_manager.contracts, which the schema language cannot express).

runner_image.description: digest-pinned image reference the job will run in.

reason.description: Present iff outcome is not assigned. code is a closed enum so a consumer can branch without parsing prose; detail is for humans and is capped.
